## A clear starting point

Good work gets easier when the starting line is visible. This site is a lightweight home for notes, experiments, and the decisions that move a project forward.

## Where studies stand

<div class="status-graphic">
<img src="assets/aact_status_distribution.svg" alt="Horizontal bar chart showing all 14 overall-status categories among 602,514 AACT studies. Terminated studies are highlighted in coral, with counts and percentages shown for every category." />
</div>

This first-pass view uses the existing AACT candidate dataset and keeps every reported status category separate. It highlights `TERMINATED` without labeling the remaining studies as completed or implying that any status causes another.

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Notice

Pay attention to the useful signal: what changed, what matters, and what is ready for a closer look.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Shape

Give promising ideas enough structure to become something you can test, share, and improve.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Move

Keep the next step small enough to take today, then let momentum do its quiet work.
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Start where the work is

The first version does not need to be complete. It needs to be real enough to teach you what comes next.
:::
